raw_segments.text: Well, the only thing I can tell you is this," said Smurdiakov, as though thinking better
I am here as an old friend and neighbor, and it would be odd if I didn't come.
On the other hand, Ivan Fyodorovich sent me first thing this morning to your brothers
lodging in Lake Street, without a letter, but with a message to Dmitry Fyodorovich
to go to dine with him at the restaurant here, in the marketplace.
I went, but didn't find Dmitry Fyodorovich at home, though it was eight o'clock.
He's been here, but he is quite gone.
Those were the very words of his landlady.
It's as though there was an understanding between them.
Perhaps at this moment, he is in the restaurant with Ivan Fyodorovich, for Ivan Fyodorovich
has not been home to dinner and Fyodor Pavlovich dined alone an hour ago, and is gone to lie
But I beg you most particularly not to speak of me and of what I have told you, for he'd
kill me for nothing at all.
